previousFix.description: Root cause: MealPrefsSheet always showed all 3 cooking-style questions even if the user already answered them in a prior session. Fix: pendingQuestions filters CHIP_QUESTIONS to those not already answered in initialPrefs; if all are answered, onDone is called immediately (no sheet shown). Users who already answered cooking style / cook time / spice level skip straight to the build.

judge.note: MealPrefsSheet.tsx:81-91 pendingQuestions useMemo filters by initialPrefs; nothingToAsk=true calls onDone immediately. Questions already in saved draft are skipped.
